mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at or below 0.25% (as observed in the current environment) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition, indicated by the unemployment rate exceeding 8.5%, signals a potential for economic stimulus and equity market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.5 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and the employment level (PAYEMS) is falling, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that triggers a flight to quality and risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rising AND PAYEMS falling and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases the discount rate for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 225 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 (INDPRO < 90) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 90 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market weakness, indicated by housing starts (HOUST) falling below 500, signals a contraction in the housing sector that triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 500 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) is declining below 390000 and housing starts (HOUST) are falling below 550, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 390000 AND HOUST < 550 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 90, it indicates a strong economy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 90 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.
